newsitem.title: USA: Marshall & Ilsley Corp Q3 net off.
newsitem.headline: Marshall & Ilsley Corp Q3 net off.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 Q3, nine month results are after special charges. During the 1996 Q3, the company completed the acquisition of EastPoint Technology Inc. In conjunction with that, it wrote off $12.1 million ($7.9 million after taxes, or $0.08/shr) of research and development costs.
Also during the Q3, the company took a charge of $2.8 million ($1.8 million after taxes, or $0.02/shr), for the special assessment associated with Savings Association Insurance Fund deposits.

Marshall & Ilsley said before special charges, 1996 Q3 net income was $54.7 million. On a fully diluted basis EPS were $0.55 and primary EPS $0.55. For the nine months, 1996 income before special charges was $151.2 million. On a fully diluted basis, EPS were $1.50 and primary EPS $1.53.
